//bundleIdentifier: PROPOSED, NOT CONFIRMED — the owner must approve this string before
any build is run. A bundle identifier is PERMANENT once published:
changing it later means a new app record, a new listing, no reviews,
and every existing install orphaned. The reasoning, the alternative
that was considered, and the two things the owner has to verify
first are written out in EAS-BUILD.md next to this file.

//package: The same string as the iOS bundle identifier, deliberately: one
identity for one product. Equally permanent — Google Play will not
let an application id change after the first release. Same approval

//: THE APP PLAYS AUDIO AND HAS NEVER RECORDED ANY.
nothing anywhere calls a recorder. Left bare, this plugin adds
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription to the iOS Info.plist and
RECORD_AUDIO to the Android manifest — a microphone permission
for a microphone that is never opened. Apple asks about a
declared capability the app does not use, Google Play's data
form asks the same, and both are avoidable by saying no here.
This was invisible in Expo Go, which has its own Info.plist.
STILL AN OPEN DECISION: `enableBackgroundPlayback` defaults to
true and adds UIBackgroundModes: audio. It is left ON because
Kai Live may legitimately keep talking while the phone is
locked. If it does not, turn it off — a declared background
audio mode the app never uses is a documented rejection reason.
